A02.query: What happens if my attendance is below the required percentage?
A02.answer_preview:

A02.full_answer:
Under University Ordinance ORD-ACAD-7.2, if your attendance falls below the mandatory 75% threshold:
1. Attendance between 60.0% and 74.9%: You may apply for Dean's Attendance Condonation (Form AC-04) by submitting authentic medical certificates or official university representation letters at least 10 working days prior to examinations.
2. Attendance below 60.0%: Condonation is strictly impermissible. You will be debarred from taking end-term semester exams for that course and must repeat the course during the summer term or next academic cycle.

AI01.query: What is the official withdrawal procedure?
AI01.answer_preview:
Aisha, the verified procedure for university withdrawal and fee refund (Ordinance ORD-WTH-14.1 & UGC directives) is:

1....
AI01.full_answer:
Aisha, the verified procedure for university withdrawal and fee refund (Ordinance ORD-WTH-14.1 & UGC directives) is:

1. UGC Tuition Refund Slabs:
   • 15+ days prior to admission deadline: 100% refund (minus max ₹1,000 processing fee)
   • Less than 15 days prior to deadline: 90% refund
   • Up to 15 days post admission deadline: 80% refund
   • 16 to 30 days post admission deadline: 50% refund
   • Beyond 30 days post deadline: 0% tuition refund.

2. Refundable Caution Deposit (₹10,000): Your ₹10,000 caution deposit is 100% refundable across all calendar dates. Minor dues or ₹200 lost ID replacement fees are settled on screen via 1-tap Smart Caution Deposit Offsetting without visiting cash counters.

3. 4-Gate Digital Clearance Pipeline:
   • Gate 1 (Central Library): Automated digital audit for returned books and dues.
   • Gate 2 (Hostel & Mess - Conditional): Verified automatically by system. For day-scholars, this gate is automatically marked BYPASSED / NOT APPLICABLE; for residential hostellers, the Warden completes digital inventory sign-off.
   • Gate 3 (Finance & Accounts): Digital fee audit, UGC slab application, and deposit ledger reconciliation.
   • Gate 4 (Registrar Digital Review): Notesheet verification and instant generation of the official Clearance Slip & No-Dues PDF (/withdrawal/{ref}/slip).

4. Application & Real-time Tracking: Submit your application directly on this kiosk portal (/withdrawal/flow) and track each gate in real time. If any desk exceeds the 48-hour SLA, raise an instant digital ticket via the Grievance Desk (/chat).

👤 Active Student Session (Aisha): You can initiate or track your live clearance pipeline, trigger 1-tap caution deposit offsets, and download your approved clearance slip under '/withdrawal'.
